# Chore: Commit DevRank Data Artifacts

Commit the initial dataset and tracking files generated by the DevRank Spider and Updater.

**Files:**
- `apps/devrank/resources/data.json`: The enriched user database.
- `apps/devrank/resources/users.json`: The user index (now an Object).
- `apps/devrank/resources/visited.json`: The visited graph state.
- `apps/devrank/resources/blacklist.json`: The exclusion list.
